motor.quote: A 300W rear hub motor (819W peak) with 28Nm of torque supplies power and speed quicker than ever before. Stealth M24 technology delivers a quieter motor experience without sacrificing power.

Lectric spec’d the XP Lite 3 with their Stealth M24 rear hub motor: 300W nominal, 819W peak, and 28Nm of torque. Going into this review, I was a little nervous about its hill-climbing ability given the modest 28Nm rating.

height.quote: Good height range and fit adjustability. With 11 inches of adjustment at the seat post and 3 inches at the quill stem, the bike does a good job fitting the claimed 4'8" to 6'2" height range.
